newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan ruling party to invest US$110 mln in Alaska.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan ruling party to invest US$110 mln in Alaska.

text.p: Two firms owned by Taiwan's ruling Nationalist Party said on Wednesday they planned to invest US$110 million to form a fish processing company in Alaska.

Central Investment Holding Co and Asia-Pacific Holdings Corp will pour a combined US$26 million into the project and seek low-interest loans to fund the rest, a spokesman for the party's business management committee said by telephone.
"We have been evaluating the project for about a year, and now we feel it is definitely going to come through," the spokesman, who declined to be named, said.
The spokesman said he did not know when the project would start.
"That would depend on how soon we get the loans we need," he said.
The Nationalist Party, one of the richest in the world with total assets of T$37.8 billion (US$1.4 billion), said the project would yield annual sales of US$350 million after it was completed.
The Nationalist Party has seven holding companies and investments in 121 firms.
